scope: Evaluation-only sensitivity to the legacy URDF calf torque-speed envelope; no hardware calibration or policy selection
preserved: Existing DCMotor torque-speed clipping, robot morphology, hip/thigh settings, kp/kd, observations and heading controller
selection: No new checkpoint or retuning; original final acceptance remains unchanged
limits: Neither envelope has been measured on the user's Go2 EDU. This is a model sensitivity experiment, not a claim about its actual hardware. Delay, thermal derating, motor-strength uncertainty and battery state are not covered.
